question: Will Google release Gemini 3 in 2025?
context:
Google has released Gemini 1.0 (Dec 2023), Gemini 1.5 (Feb 2024), and Gemini 2.0 (Dec 2024).
Consider:
- Google's release cadence and patterns
- Gemini 2.0 features and current capabilities
- Industry competition (OpenAI, Anthropic)
- Google's public statements and roadmap
- Historical release timing patterns

models.name: Base Rate Model
models.description: Historical frequency of major version releases by Google within calendar years

models.name: Inside View Model (Causal/Mechanistic)
models.description: Build from specific factors: development timeline, Pichai's statements, competitive pressure, and resource availability

models.name: Outside View Model (Reference Class Forecasting)
models.description: Compare to similar situations in AI industry - how often do major tech companies release next major version within promised year?

models.name: Trend Extrapolation Model
models.description: Analyze Google's accelerating release cadence and project forward
